title: BrowserStack real iPhone test fails before page launch on reducedMotion capability mismatch
reproduction: Run the BrowserStack Map Forge Real iPhone workflow on main.
Allow credentials, Pages deployment wait and dependency install to complete.
Start the real iPhone Playwright test through browserstack-node-sdk.
Observe browser context creation fail before page.goto can validate the game.
expected: BrowserStack creates the real iPhone Safari context and the test reaches the deployed KELO WORLD page.
actual: browser.newContext fails because BrowserStack expects reducedMotion 'none' while the provided value is 'no-preference'.
evidence: Error: expectedValue of reducedMotion: 'none' does not match providedValue: 'no-preference'

research.summary: The BrowserStack real-device gate fails before navigation because the resolved Playwright/SDK context contains a reducedMotion value BrowserStack rejects. A previous capability simplification did not remove the injected value, so the unresolved question is where the final context value is introduced.

known_facts.statement: The failure occurs during browser.newContext before page.goto reaches KELO WORLD.
BrowserStack reports expected reducedMotion 'none' but receives 'no-preference'.
evidence: Error: expectedValue of reducedMotion: 'none' does not match providedValue: 'no-preference'

known_facts.statement: Removing some explicit mobile capabilities previously did not eliminate the mismatch.
evidence: Existing fix.summary in BUG-0001 before schema v2 migration

hypotheses.theory: The resolved Playwright device/project configuration injects reducedMotion='no-preference' after BrowserStack configuration is applied.
hypotheses.why: The rejected value appears at browser context creation even after a prior attempt to let BrowserStack own mobile capabilities.
hypotheses.test_next: Print or otherwise inspect the final Playwright project/use/context options passed through the BrowserStack SDK and compare them with a minimal project that does not spread a Playwright device descriptor.

hypotheses.theory: browserstack.yml or BrowserStack SDK capability normalization conflicts with a Playwright default even when the project does not explicitly set reducedMotion.
hypotheses.why: The SDK transforms Playwright configuration before real-device session creation, so the mismatch may be introduced during that transform rather than by the test file.
hypotheses.test_next: Run one minimal real-device smoke spec with a stripped Playwright project and compare the session creation result before changing game tests.

unknowns.question: Which exact configuration layer supplies reducedMotion='no-preference' to the final BrowserStack context?
unknowns.why_it_matters: Fixing the wrong config file will repeat the failed capability-cleanup attempt.
unknowns.quickest_test: Inspect/log the resolved Playwright project and SDK-transformed capabilities in the minimal failing workflow.

attempt_history.goal: Remove the reducedMotion mismatch by allowing BrowserStack to own mobile capabilities.

change.summary: Simplified ownership of mobile capabilities so BrowserStack would supply device capabilities.

validation.method: Run the real-device workflow through browserstack-node-sdk.
evidence: Mismatch remained after the capability-ownership attempt.

attempt_history.conclusion: Simply removing/ceding explicit mobile capabilities is insufficient; the final injected reducedMotion value must be located before another config edit.
attempt_history.do_not_repeat_without: Evidence identifying a different resolved capability set or configuration layer than the one used by the failed attempt.

next_best_actions.action: Capture the final resolved Playwright project/use options and BrowserStack SDK capability payload for the failing session, specifically the origin of reducedMotion.
next_best_actions.reason: This directly identifies the layer injecting the rejected value and prevents another blind config edit.
next_best_actions.expected_signal: A single config/device descriptor/default can be named as the source of 'no-preference'.
next_best_actions.stop_condition: If the resolved Playwright config contains no reducedMotion but the SDK payload does, move investigation to BrowserStack SDK normalization instead of game/test config.

next_best_actions.action: Create/run a minimal one-page real-iPhone smoke project without Playwright device spreading and compare session creation.
next_best_actions.reason: A differential test separates Playwright project injection from BrowserStack SDK/service behavior.
next_best_actions.expected_signal: Minimal project either opens a session or reproduces the same mismatch.
next_best_actions.stop_condition: Once the responsible layer is isolated, stop modifying unrelated World/Guest tests and fix only that layer.

fix.summary: A previous attempt to let BrowserStack own mobile capabilities did not remove the mismatch; root source of reducedMotion injection is still unresolved.

verification.method: Workflow must create Safari context on the configured real iPhone and reach page.goto.

notes: This is a test-harness/integration defect, not evidence that Guest or World itself fails on the device.
Do not mark downstream iPhone bugs verified while this gate prevents the real-device flow from executing.
